notes.title: Updates and package changes work again on Stable 1.1.1 and later (the updater lost the selected update channel)
Systems on 1.1.1 to 1.1.4 need a one-time console command before this update; see the 1.1.5 release notes
Threat Shield 1.1.0: GeoIP country blocking and DNS redirection rules are now loaded into the firewall (known issue of 1.1.0)
Threat Shield 1.1.0: protection levels, allowlist with one-click Unblock, IP threat lists, DNS-over-TLS and DNS-over-HTTPS blocking, pause and schedules
Threat Shield 1.1.0: inbound protection with DNSBL reputation checks and flood limits for exposed services
Threat Shield 1.1.0: live threat map with a full-screen view in three styles and a dashboard widget
Threat Shield 1.1.0: health checks with one-click fixes and a one-switch setup
